entry.title: New: Resolution 181 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE UNIVERSITY OF HAWAIʻI OFFICE OF RESEARCH SERVICES

Allows the County to provide a $125,000 grant to the Pacific Aquaculture and Coastal Resource Center for permits and preliminary research to develop an aquaculture project in Hilo Bay.
